directions.action: Conduct a spot inspection to ascertain the nature and extent of unauthorized construction
directions.source_quote:
A spot inspection shall be conducted to ascertain
the nature and extent of unauthorized construction.

directions.action: Take necessary steps to deal with unauthorized construction in accordance with law if found in violation or devoid of sanction plan
directions.source_quote:
In the event the aforesaid respondent is of the
considered opinion that the construction has been
made either in violation of the plan sanctioned or
devoid the sanction plan, then necessary steps shall be
taken to deal with such unauthorized construction, in
accordance with law.

directions.action: Restrict the consideration of the representation with regard to unauthorized construction only and not enter into or decide any private dispute
directions.source_quote:
The aforesaid respondent shall restrict the
consideration of the representation with regard to
unauthorized construction only and not enter into or
decide any private dispute of the parties regarding
right, title and interest in respect of the aforesaid land.

directions.action: Forward a copy of the representation dated 30th November, 2019 to the aforesaid respondent at the time of communicating the order
directions.source_quote:
